title: LettaPing

message_type.title: Message Type
message_type.description: The type of the message. Ping messages are a keep-alive to prevent SSE streams from timing out during long running requests.

otid.title: Otid
otid.description: The offline threading id (OTID). Set by the client to deduplicate requests. Used for idempotency in background streaming mode — each message in a request must have a unique OTID. Retries of the same request should reuse the same OTIDs.

description:
A ping message used as a keepalive to prevent SSE streams from timing out during long running requests.

Args:
    id (str): The ID of the message
    date (datetime): The date the message was created in ISO format
